scene: The warm caramel is delicious! Three exits now beckon.
picture: Flat side view. In the refinery, the South Asian girl in her purple wheelchair sits left of centre, licking a caramel spoon. On the far left, an open hangar door reveals a tethered brass airship. Right, a yellow striped delivery truck idles. On the far right stands the glowing glass elevator.
